metadata.notes: All entries verified against organization websites and directory listings as of last_full_review date. Hours and eligibility rules change. Call ahead when possible. Each entry shows last_verified; treat anything over 90 days old as potentially stale.

resources.name: Menifee Valley Community Cupboard

address.notes: Sun City is the neighborhood name; this is within the City of Menifee boundaries.

resources.hours_notes: Closed Saturday and Sunday. Closed on major holidays; call to confirm around holiday periods.

eligibility.zip_notes: Primarily serves 92584, 92585, 92586, and the Quail Valley/Cottonwood Canyon portions of 92587. If your ZIP is not listed, call — they will help you find the nearest resource.

what_to_bring: Social Security card for each household member
Proof of residency (utility bill, lease, etc.)
services: Home delivery available for those without transportation (call to arrange)

resources.name: God's Helping Hand Food Banks
resources.hours_notes: Wednesdays only, 10 AM to noon. Call ahead to confirm, especially around holidays.

eligibility.zip_notes: No ZIP restriction found; serves community members in need.

resources.reverification_reason: Two different phone numbers in different sources. Confirm which is current. As of 2026-07-11: generic food-bank aggregators (food-banks.org, californiafoodpantry.org) consistently return (951) 973-3582, but Manta.com and findhelp.org (a more curated benefits-navigation directory) independently return (951) 679-4667. This is the first run where the two source clusters disagree this clearly rather than one number simply reappearing. Needs an actual phone call, not another search.

resources.name: Salvation Army Murrieta Corps

address.notes: Located in Murrieta, approximately 7 miles from central Menifee.

resources.hours_notes: Appointment required. Call ext. 2 to schedule. Do not arrive without an appointment.

eligibility.service_area: Murrieta, Menifee, Temecula, Lake Elsinore, Wildomar
eligibility.frequency: One food box per household per month.

resources.what_to_bring_notes: Requirements not confirmed. Confirm when you call for your appointment.

resources.name: MilVet Food & Household Pantry

address.notes: Located in Murrieta. Serves veterans and military families in Menifee and surrounding cities.

resources.hours_notes: Tuesdays 1 PM to 5 PM, walk-in. No appointment needed.

eligibility.service_area: Temecula, Murrieta, Menifee, Lake Elsinore, Riverside, Hemet, Wildomar, Nuevo, Winchester
eligibility.income_requirement: Veterans, active military, and their families.

what_to_bring: Proof of military service (DD-214, military ID, VA card, or similar)

resources.name: MSJC Food 4 Thought Pantry — Menifee Valley Campus

address.notes: Room 2106 at the Menifee Valley Campus of Mt. San Jacinto College.

resources.hours_notes: Closed the 4th Wednesday of each month for delivery and restocking. Hours effective November 2025; confirm current hours before visiting.
what_to_bring: Student ID or proof of enrollment

resources.name: Riverside County Home Delivered Meals Program

address.notes: County-wide program. Meals delivered to your home. No fixed pickup location.

resources.phone_notes: HelpLink Information & Assistance line. Call to start intake and determine eligibility.
resources.hours_notes: Office hours Mon–Fri 9 AM–4 PM for intake calls. Meal delivery schedule set after enrollment.

eligibility.requirement: Adults age 60+ or adults with a disability who are homebound and unable to prepare their own meals.
eligibility.service_area: All of Riverside County, including Menifee.
eligibility.income_requirement: No income requirement stated; need-based prioritization.

resources.what_to_bring_notes: Phone intake. No office visit required to start.
services: Hot or frozen meals delivered to your home

resources.name: City of Menifee Food Box Distribution

address.notes: La Ladera Park. Location may vary by event; confirm each time.

hours.event_hours: 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM on event days

resources.hours_notes: This is a periodic event, not a weekly service. Dates in 2025 included March 27 and December 18. Check cityofmenifee.us for the current schedule. Onsite registration required.

eligibility.income_requirement: Not specified. Open to community members.

resources.what_to_bring_notes: Onsite registration; bring ID to confirm Menifee residency.
